2.163.33
GaugePanel.StateIndicators
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.StateIndicators element is of type StateIndicators. The
GaugePanel.StateIndicators element is ignored in any schema version prior to RDL 2010/01.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.StateIndicators element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.StateIndicators element.
 <xsd:element name="StateIndicators" type="StateIndicatorsType" minOccurs="0" />
